text:
Predicates:
JapaneseCompany(x) ::: x is a Japanese game company.
Game(x) ::: x is a game.
Created(x, y) ::: x created y.
Top10(y) ::: y is on the Top 10 list.
MadeBy(y, x) ::: y is made by x.
SellsMoreThanOneMillion(y) ::: y sells more than one million copies.

Premises:
Created(japaneseGameCompany, legendOfZelda) ::: A Japanese game company created the game the Legend of Zelda.
∀y (Top10(y) → ∃x (JapaneseCompany(x) ∧ MadeBy(y, x))) ::: All games on the Top 10 list are made by Japanese game companies.
SellsMoreThanOneMillion(legendOfZelda) → Top10(legendOfZelda) ::: If a game sells more than one million copies, then it will be included in the Top 10 list.
SellsMoreThanOneMillion(legendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda sold more than one million copies.

Conclusion:
Top10(legendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda is on the Top 10 list.
